scope: Actual bounded paper runner-exit selection and prospective paired research; complete entry-policy AutoResearch transport remains a separate required block

implementation.enrollment: Only the first actual partial-fill event of an explicit non-test 0.1 SOL paper trade with current run identity, raw SPL quantity basis, entry route evidence and frozen estimated costs; no historical or supplied aggregate metrics are accepted
implementation.common_prefix: All arms share the same entry, paid first partial, remaining units and previous fees. Subsequent partial ladders and terminal exits are independently evaluated
implementation.bounded_variants: Incumbent price drawdown and its valid +/-5 percentage-point neighbours, within the existing 5-40 percent bounds; activation, hard holding horizon, stops, safety and sizing cannot change
implementation.observations: Reuse current position-monitor prices and liquidity. Reuse already-observed exit quotes only when a pending virtual intent has exactly the same raw token quantity. Continue sampling unresolved virtual positions after the actual paper position closes
implementation.secondary_budget: At least 60 seconds between secondary cycles, at most one additional raw-quantity quote call per cycle, and at most 128 active cases. Existing batched price caching/chunking is reused; no swaps or RPC signing calls are made. Underlying quote fallback may perform more than one HTTP request
implementation.accounting: Conserve raw units, SOL proceeds, USD proceeds and every estimated fill fee. Record actual research intent/fill timestamps; do not fabricate unavailable prices or routes
implementation.concurrency: Persist intents before awaits, reload after network waits and recheck exact intent identity so a reused primary quote cannot be overwritten or counted twice
implementation.selection: Prerecorded daily enrollment cohort, all arms terminal and finite, at least 50 case-sensitive independent mints, at least 24 hours of observed trade window, fresh completed evidence, no capacity/observation-coverage gaps, and positive net candidate returns in both SOL and USD with positive paired token-cluster bootstrap lower deltas adjusted for testing two neighbours
implementation.evidence_integrity: Require route counts, cash conservation, monotonic/future-safe clocks, bounded settlement horizon and consistent same-instant quotes. Manifest readers revalidate the original closed records and their checksums; cached verification is invalidated by changed manifest, evidence or source-file metadata
implementation.application: Atomic role-limited manifest consumed by real paper buy path for NEW entry snapshots only; selected runner settings remain frozen in the portfolio, buy response and existing SQL policy field
implementation.rollback: A later comparable cohort can select the previous incumbent as a checked rollback. Preserve selection history. Corrupt, missing, expired or incompatible evidence falls back to the configured static paper policy
implementation.live_behavior: Live reads/ticks cannot enable, apply or query this paper experiment; no live flags or private credentials can be changed

tests.publishing_preflight: PASS with no compile, config, profile, empty-data report or live-template errors
tests.qualification: Test quotes, comparison cohorts and cadence metadata are synthetic fixtures, not observed profitable trading

current_financial_evidence: No bot run or research policy was activated by this implementation. No prospective winning policy is certified
remaining_full_goal_requirements: Complete generalized entry-policy/scanner champion-challenger transport and risk/continuation uncertainty validation, beyond this runner-exit component
Complete architecture/integration failure-path audit and check all first-launch control surfaces
Obtain authorized fresh prospective paper evidence before any profitability or live-promotion claim
Publish verified source changes and leave all runtime services stopped
